skill.name: django-pro
skill.description: Get Django 5.x guidance for architecture, APIs, async features, testing, security, performance, and deployment.
skill.summary: Design and improve production Django applications with practical, security-aware guidance.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: The only static finding is a false positive caused by a Markdown path enclosed in backticks. No executable code, command invocation, prompt injection, or malicious intent was found in SKILL.md.

static_findings.snippet: - If detailed examples are required, open `resources/implementation-playbook.md`.

finding_verdicts.reason: SKILL.md line 24 uses backticks only to format the relative Markdown path resources/implementation-playbook.md; it does not invoke a shell or execute a command.

content.value_statement: Django projects often need coordinated decisions across architecture, security, data access, testing, and deployment. This skill provides practical Django 5.x guidance for those decisions.
actual_capabilities: Recommends Django 5.x architecture, project structure, settings, and reusable application boundaries.
Designs REST APIs with Django REST Framework, authentication, permissions, serializers, and tests.
Reviews ORM usage for query counts, relationships, indexes, transactions, and database performance.
Guides async views, ASGI deployment, Django Channels, Celery tasks, caching, and real-time features.
Identifies Django security concerns involving authentication, authorization, CSRF, CORS, XSS, and SQL usage.
Proposes testing and deployment approaches using pytest-django, Docker, application servers, and CI pipelines.
limitations: The skill provides guidance and generated changes, but it cannot verify behavior without access to the project and runtime.
Recommendations require validation against the exact Django, Python, database, and dependency versions.
It does not replace production security review, load testing, migration rehearsal, or operational monitoring.
The referenced implementation playbook is not included in the scanned skill package.

use_cases.title: Plan a New Django Service
use_cases.description: Define application boundaries, models, API layers, settings, tests, and deployment choices for a maintainable service.
use_cases.target_user: Backend developer starting a Django project

use_cases.title: Improve a Slow Application
use_cases.description: Review query patterns, indexes, caching, task queues, and async boundaries to create a measured optimization plan.
use_cases.target_user: Technical lead maintaining a high-traffic application

use_cases.title: Review Security and Release Readiness
use_cases.description: Assess authentication, permissions, middleware, secrets, tests, migrations, and production configuration before deployment.
use_cases.target_user: Engineering team preparing a Django release

prompt_templates.title: Explain a Django Choice
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain when to use [Django feature] for [project goal]. Include benefits, risks, a simple implementation outline, and validation steps.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Django Feature
prompt_templates.prompt: Design [feature] for a Django 5.x application using [database and dependencies]. Cover models, views, permissions, tests, and migration needs.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose Performance
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Django performance problem: [symptoms and relevant project details]. Identify likely causes, measurements, ORM improvements, caching options, and regression tests.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Production Architecture
prompt_templates.prompt: Propose a production Django architecture for [requirements and scale]. Address APIs, async work, data integrity, security, observability, deployment, failure modes, and rollout.
prompt_templates.scenario: Architect evaluating a complex Django system

output_examples.input: Our order list performs hundreds of queries. How should we investigate?
output: Measure query counts for the view and serializer before changing code.
Map related fields to select_related or prefetch_related based on relationship type.
Add a regression test that limits queries for a representative order list.

output_examples.input: Design permissions for a multi-tenant DRF endpoint.
output_examples.output: Scope every queryset to the active tenant, enforce membership before object access, and test cross-tenant list, detail, update, and delete requests.

output_examples.input: Should a long report run inside an async Django view?
output_examples.output: Use a task queue for durable report generation. Return a job identifier, expose status, make tasks idempotent, and define retries and timeouts.

best_practices: Provide Django, Python, database, and dependency versions with relevant project constraints.
Share focused models, queries, settings, errors, and tests while removing credentials and personal data.
Validate generated recommendations with automated tests, migration checks, query measurements, and staging deployment.
anti_patterns: Do not request architecture guidance without scale, consistency, security, and operational requirements.
Do not apply ORM optimizations without measuring queries and confirming result correctness.
Do not deploy generated settings, migrations, or authentication changes without environment-specific review.

faq.question: Which Django versions does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It focuses on Django 5.x. Verify every recommendation against your installed Django and dependency versions.

faq.question: Can it help with Django REST Framework?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers serializers, views, authentication, permissions, testing, and API architecture.

faq.question: Does it support async Django applications?
faq.answer: Yes. It can guide async views, middleware, ASGI deployment, Channels, and appropriate boundaries for background tasks.

faq.question: Can it optimize Django ORM queries?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide models, query code, query counts, and database details for specific recommendations.

faq.question: Will it run or deploy my application?
faq.answer: No. Execution and deployment depend on available tools, project access, permissions, and your environment.

faq.question: Is its security guidance a complete audit?
faq.answer: No. Use dedicated security review, dependency scanning, configuration checks, and production monitoring for release decisions.
